sections.summary: All Family Violence Specialist Centres and the PAVE centre will provide comprehensive support for intra- and extra-familial violence, including sexual violence, by second half of 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: All Family Violence Specialist Centres and the PAVE Integrated Services for Individual and Family Protection Specialist Centre will be able to provide comprehensive support for all forms of intra- and extra-familial violence, including sexual violence, by the second half of 2022.

sections.label: IHL respect modules
sections.summary: Most IHLs already have compulsory modules on respect and appropriate behaviour, and remaining IHLs will roll out such modules by mid-2022.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: Most IHLs already have compulsory modules on respect and appropriate behaviour for students today, and the remaining IHLs will roll out such modules by mid-2022.

sections.label: NTU POWERS programme
sections.summary: NTU's POWERS programme aims to recruit and empower women with a long-term goal of increasing gender diversity in STEM careers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: For example, NTU’s Promotion of Women in Engineering, Research and Science (POWERS) programme aims to recruit and empower women with a long-term goal of increasing gender diversity in STEM careers.

sections.label: AFAM single parent support
sections.summary: AFAM focuses on supporting single parents, and MSF will partner Daughters Of Tomorrow to pilot a child-minding service for low-income women, including single parents.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: The Alliance for Action to Strengthen Marriages and Family Relationships (AFAM) has a focal area on supporting single parents and we are looking into single parents’ access to information, alternative childcare arrangements and socioemotional support tailored to address the high stress and stigma faced by single parents.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: MSF will partner Daughters Of Tomorrow (DOT) to pilot a child-minding service for low-income women, including single parents, outside childcare operating hours.

sections.label: HDB single unwed parents
sections.summary: HDB assured that single unwed parents will be informed of their public rental application outcome within three weeks of receiving all required information.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: On housing, HDB has assured that, following their public rental application, single unwed parents will be informed of the outcome within three weeks of receiving all required information.

sections.label: Shelter stays and single unwed parents
sections.summary: Shelter stays may be extended if social workers assess more time is needed, and 12 line items are available to every Singaporean child regardless of parents' marital status.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: While the shelters aim to help the residents move into long-term stable housing within six months, we understand that some residents may require a longer time to do so.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: Hence, we will extend their stays if social workers assess that they need more time to work on the issues that they face.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: Mr Louis Ng suggested that the full suite of Marriage and Parenthood incentives be made available to single unwed parents.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: I had shared at my COS speech in February this year that 12 line items, which include MediSave Grant for Newborns, Infant Care Subsidy, Childcare Subsidy, Child Development Account, and so on, are available to every Singaporean child, regardless of the marital status of their parents.

sections.label: Help for older women with limited savings
sections.summary: The Government will help women approaching retirement age with limited savings through schemes such as the Home Caregiving Grant and Silver Support Scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: The Government will also help women who have contributed to their families for many years and are approaching retirement age but have limited savings through schemes, such as the Home Caregiving Grant and Silver Support Scheme.

sections.label: Upper age limit for donor eggs
sections.summary: The upper age limit of 35 years old is pegged to existing age limits for donor eggs for Assisted Reproduction Treatment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: The upper age limit of 35 years old is pegged to the existing age limits for donor eggs for Assisted Reproduction Treatment.

sections.label: Frozen egg baby chance
sections.summary: According to the American Society for Reproductive Medicine, the chance a frozen egg will yield a baby is currently 2% to 12%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: According to the American Society for Reproductive Medicine, the chance that a frozen egg will yield a baby currently stands at 2% to 12%.

sections.label: Pre-procedure counselling for women
sections.summary: To guard against misinformation and help women make an informed choice, women will have to undergo pre-procedure counselling.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: To guard against misinformation, and to help women make an informed choice, women will have to undergo pre-procedure counselling.

sections.label: Tripartite Guidelines on FWAs
sections.summary: The Tripartite Guidelines on FWAs will be implemented about two years from now.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: On workplaces, the Tripartite Guidelines on FWAs will be implemented about two years from now.

sections.label: Support for caregivers
sections.summary: Members including Miss Rachel Ong and Mr Vikram Nair welcomed the enhancement of the Home Caregiving Grant.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: On support for caregivers, many Members, such as Miss Rachel Ong and Mr Vikram Nair, have welcomed the enhancement of the Home Caregiving Grant.

sections.label: Workplace fairness legislation
sections.summary: New legislation on workplace fairness, championed by Labour MPs, builds on gains boosting female employment in every age group.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Likewise, for workplace fairness, which Labour Members of Parliament have actively championed and worked on the ground to achieve for years, new legislation builds on the steady gains we have already made to boost female employment in every age group.

sections.label: White Paper implementation pace
sections.summary: It seems contrary to calls to move faster on implementation, as the fully implemented White Paper promises a fairer, more inclusive society.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: It also seems contrary to calls on the Government to move faster not on recommendations but on implementation.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: This is because, when fully implemented, the White Paper promises to realise more closely our vision of a fairer and more inclusive society where men and women partner each other as equals and can pursue their aspirations freely and to the fullest.

sections.label: Rejecting Confucius saying on women
sections.summary: Confucius said lack of talent in a woman is a virtue, but in modern-day Singapore this debate firmly rejects such narrow-mindedness.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Confucius had a famous saying, "女子无才便是德", meaning the lack of talent in a woman is a virtue.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: It is clear from this debate that here, in modern-day Singapore, we firmly reject such narrow-mindedness towards women.

sections.label: Women as equal partners
sections.summary: Women should be equal partners of men at work and at home, and more for girls and women does not mean less for boys and men.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Women should be regarded as equal partners of men not only at work but also at home.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: We believe that more for girls and women does not mean less for boys and men.

sections.label: Honouring Singapore women
sections.summary: This White Paper is about honouring Singapore women, recognising their place in society and committing to further progress for women.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: More than anything else, this White Paper is about honouring Singapore women, recognising their place in society and committing to achieve further progress for women.

sections.label: White Paper on Singapore women
sections.summary: The White Paper aims to build a fairer, more inclusive society where Singapore women partner men as equals with mutual respect and pursue their aspirations freely and fully.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: At its core, the White Paper seeks to build a fairer and more inclusive society where Singapore women, partnering men as equals, with mutual respect, can pursue and fulfil their aspirations freely and fully.

sections.label: Looking back on women's progress
sections.summary: Looking back, more stories, honoured women, collective actions and ground-up initiatives would show efforts bore fruit and hearts aligned for women's development.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Years later, when we look back, it is the fact of so many more stories to tell, so many more women to honour, that we know today's efforts have borne fruit.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Years later, when we look back, it is the fact of so many more collective actions, so many more ground-up initiatives, that we see the power of alignment in hearts and minds towards the common cause of women's development.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Years later, when we look back, this must be a moment to celebrate, because we leaned forward to achieve greater progress for Singapore women, we put our values into action once again and jointly ushered in a new dawn, leading to a fairer and more inclusive society, where more women partner men as equals, fulfil more of our aspirations freely and fully!
